title: On Johnson-Lindenstrauss Transforms for Byzantine-Robust Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.27989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing scale of data and models in machine learning calls for efficient optimization methods. Distributed optimization addresses this challenge, with compression mechanisms helping to reduce communication costs. A classical tool for dimensionality reduction is the Johnson-Lindenstrauss (JL) transform, which is simple to implement and offers strong geometric guarantees. In particular, JL transforms approximately preserve inner products and pairwise distances between vectors with high probability. In this paper, we exploit this property in Byzantine-robust optimization, where worker messages are weighted according to their alignment with a trusted reference gradient. We further support our theoretical findings with experimental results.

translated_title: 关于Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换在拜占庭鲁棒优化中的应用
translated_abstract: 机器学习中数据和模型规模的不断增长对高效的优化方法提出了需求。分布式优化应对了这一挑战，而压缩机制有助于降低通信成本。降维的一个经典工具是Johnson-Lindenstrauss（JL）变换，它实现简单且具有很强的几何保证。特别地，JL变换能够以高概率近似保持向量之间的内积和成对距离。在本文中，我们在拜占庭鲁棒优化中利用了这一特性，即根据工作节点消息与可信参考梯度的对齐程度对其进行加权。我们还通过实验结果进一步支持了理论发现。
tldr: 本文利用Johnson-Lindenstrauss变换能高概率近似保持内积和距离的几何特性，将其应用于拜占庭鲁棒优化，根据工作节点消息与可信参考梯度的对齐程度进行加权，并通过理论分析和实验验证了该方法的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper applies Johnson-Lindenstrauss transforms, which approximately preserve inner products and distances with high probability, to Byzantine-robust optimization by weighting worker messages according to their alignment with a trusted reference gradient, with both theoretical guarantees and experimental validation.
